status_payload.statement: VeilGraph Slice E compiles privacy locally, attacks the protected artifact through format-specific fail-closed release gates, then binds the result to a tamper-evident audit chain and Ed25519-signed proof certificate. The residual exposure and proof scores are calibrated product indicators, not legal guarantees of anonymity.
